title: Catapult Sakapatate - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Catapult Sakapatate in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: One of the Sakapatate family of planted enemies. Fire is the family answer and defeating this one awards Trebuchim.

sections.title: Where to Find the Catapult Sakapatate
How to Beat the Catapult Sakapatate
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Fire is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.
